title: Toddlers Play Tea Table, Whittier Calif - Vintage 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
E. W. BLEW, A. R. P. S.
MAY 4 1938
WHITTIER, CALIFORNIA

T 2
description: A charming Great Depression-era studio portrait capturing three young children seated around a small children's table, playfully drinking from tiny cups in a pretend tea party. Two of the children wear matching horizontal striped tops under overalls or pinafores. A tall floral basket of gladioli and daisies sits in the background, set against a dark fabric backdrop. The photograph was taken by E. W. Blew, A.R.P.S. (Associate of the Royal Photographic Society) in Whittier, California on May 4, 1938.
